title: Route
description: An ordered sequence of waypoints forming a navigation route.

waypointIds.description: Ordered list of Waypoint IDs (ULIDs). Duplicates allowed (e.g. return-to-start).

properties.description: Arbitrary metadata (e.g. estimated duration, fuel, tags).

deletedAt.description: Soft delete timestamp. Present means logically deleted.

revision.description: ULID – monotonically increasing. Last-Write-Wins sync uses lexicographic comparison.

originClientId.description: ULID of the client that last modified this entity
